items.question: For a Change of Control under the MSA, whose voting rights have to be acquired, Harrowgate's or Voss-Lindqvist's?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that a "Change of Control" is defined as a transaction where a person or group acquires more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting rights of the Provider [1: "Change of Control" means any transaction by which a person or group acquires more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting rights of Provider].

The Change of Control notice references Harrowgate Systems Inc. as the Provider, indicating that the voting rights in question belong to Harrowgate. The notice also states that Pellucid Holdings plc has agreed to acquire all of the shares of Harrowgate Systems Inc. [2].

Therefore, the voting rights that must be acquired for a Change of Control under the MSA are Harrowgate's.

evidence.quote: Pellucid Holdings plc has agreed to acquire all of the shares of Harrowgate Systems Inc.
